items.text: Commanders ruled out QB Jayden Daniels with left elbow injury; carted off. Last similar injury missed four games.
items.why: Awkward bend on play; carted to locker room.
items.implication: Backup QB in; multi-week concern possible.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury; imaging Monday. Walking under own power, good spirits; Bagent replaced him.
items.opportunity: Bears skill if Williams limited ROS.

items.text: Ladd McConkey is officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey is inactive; grab Jonah Coleman now if ignored in preseason.
items.why: Official active confirmation after cracked rib and optimism/flak jacket reports.
items.implication: Start McConkey as WR2; Coleman elevated as Harvey handcuff/backup look.
items.opportunity: McConkey routes/targets with docks possible; Coleman carries/snaps.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active today.
items.why: Cracked rib; practiced Friday, optimism from Rapoport, flak jacket expected.
items.implication: Clear start with possible volume docks.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey is inactive today.
49ers WR Mike Evans has a hip injury and is questionable to return today.
Packers ruled out WR Jayden Reed (neck); has feeling/movement, overnight observation.
items.implication: GB WR targets to others (Watson etc).

items.text: Eagles say RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return today.
Bengals QB Joe Burrow, listed as questionable, officially is active vs. the Texans. Also Olave, McMillan, Hendrickson active; Tua inactive.
items.why: Back for Burrow; hamstring for Olave expected to play.
items.implication: Full Bengals offense online; start both.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; Rap tone bullish, official likely ~2:30pm ET. Puka true GTD. Olave clean no docks. Harvey->Coleman look. Pittman->Bernard.
items.why: Based on weekend reports and Rapoport optimism; projections updating.
items.implication: DFS/main slate docks for McConkey; clean Olave; backup RB/WR looks.
items.opportunity: Coleman/Bernard usage spikes; McConkey routes with limitation.

items.text: Michael Pittman (foot) OUT. Expecting decent look at Germie Bernard.
Brock Bowers (knee) not expected/inactive Week 2; likely Week 3 debut. Michael Mayer primary.
items.why: Meniscus trim; limited practice Friday; Rap expected sit.
items.implication: Mayer TE1 again; Jeanty receiving bump possible.

items.text: Rams consider WR Puka Nacua (hip) a pre-game decision for Monday night vs Giants.
items.why: Hip; missed practices; true GTD per Levitan.
items.implication: Risky start; pivot needed for MNF.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave expected to play (hamstring); Chase Young also expected.
items.why: Expected per Schefter/Rap; Levitan no docks.

items.text: Seahawks rookie RB Jadarian Price questionable to return due to chest injury.
items.implication: SEA RB committee shift if out.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd first career TD; those who waited over 2 years congrats.
Agrees with Germie Bernard stash (YAC man, Pittman out, good McCarthy fit); also Sarratt with Lane/Flowers issues.
items.why: YAC fit with McCarthy; Pittman out opens door.
